auditScope: Status of the final 1.4.2 build (built 24 October 2026 at e854703, SHA-256 5c02cc26…, not yet published) against each bounty requirement, with the evidence for it. pass: met and evidenced; partial: met in part, or not yet shown on the hardware or channel the requirement names; fail: not met. release-audit.md and docs/testing-1.4.2.md have the detail.

requirements.obligation: Run on compatible Android or GrapheneOS hardware
requirements.note: The bounty asks for Android or compatible GrapheneOS hardware. The APK is arm64-v8a for Android 13 or newer, with every native library 16 KB-aligned and no Google Play Services code. It runs on a Redmi 13C (6 GB, Android 13), ran the 23 October candidate on an Infinix X6840 (4 GB, Android 16), and runs on Android 15 emulator images with no Google apps (12 GB, and 4 GB for an earlier public-key APK); not tried on a Pixel or a GrapheneOS phone.

requirements.obligation: Stay within a maximum 12 GB RAM environment
requirements.note: Qwen3.5 2B peaks at 3.45 GB and the 4B at 6.83 GB while answering (12 GB emulator, airplane mode); setup recommends the 2B below 8 GB and the 4B from 8 GB, and offers Gemma 4 26B only on phones reporting 10.5e9 bytes or more, where its weights are read from the file.

requirements.obligation: Use at most 50 GB total installed storage
requirements.note: With all three models, every collection and the voice installed, Android reports 47.58 GB of storage for the app on the 12 GB emulator (21 October); the budget check refuses installs past 50 GB.

requirements.obligation: Work completely offline after installation and asset provisioning
requirements.note: Every device check of 22 to 24 October ran in airplane mode with Wi-Fi and mobile data off: on 24 October six questions asked twice with each small model and emergencies asked while another answer ran, on the Redmi 13C; on 22 and 23 October emergencies, lookups, explanations and read aloud on the Redmi, the Infinix and the emulator.

requirements.obligation: Make no API, remote inference, web search, or network requests during use
requirements.note: Network use is limited by code to downloads the user starts and the collection list refresh. On 24 October Android's per-app counters on the Redmi 13C showed the app sending and receiving nothing during 75 minutes of questions in airplane mode, and during a cold start and 50 minutes of questions with Wi-Fi on and connected. No packet capture was made.

requirements.obligation: Require no Google Play Services for core offline behavior
requirements.note: No Play Services dependency in the code or the APK, and the 12 GB emulator image used for every Gemma check carries no Google apps at all (pm lists no com.google.android.gms).

requirements.obligation: Handle explanation, comparison, synthesis, and reasoning beyond recall
requirements.note: Explanation, comparison, synthesis and reasoning are handled. On 160 sealed questions in four sets (37, 46, 49 and 51), graded blind, Gemma 4 26B (12 GB phones) gave a good answer to 115 (72%), Qwen3.5 4B to 27 (17%) and Qwen3.5 2B to 35 (22%): 77%, 45% and 40% of the web-and-AI reference answers' average score.

requirements.obligation: Respond at speeds usable for real phone lookups
requirements.note: Lookups, guides, places and calculations answer in seconds on every phone. Model answers on a 6 GB Redmi 13C in airplane mode (24 October, six questions asked twice, timed to the complete answer): Qwen3.5 2B 88 to 153 s for simple questions and 195 to 351 s for complex ones; Qwen3.5 4B 194 to 362 s, and once 47 minutes under memory pressure with Wi-Fi on and other apps open. Gemma 4 26B: a median of 92 s on a 12 GB emulator; no 8 GB or 12 GB phone has been timed.

requirements.obligation: Publish the submission in a public GitHub repository
requirements.note: Public repository; 1.4.2 goes to main with its tag and release (B31-18).

requirements.obligation: Include all code, assets, dependencies, and reproduction instructions
requirements.note: Code, patches, pack tools and their pinned inputs.

requirements.obligation: Document models, datasets, indexes, and other resources
requirements.note: Models and every offered collection with size, checksum, source and licence.

requirements.obligation: Work on real Android hardware at submission time
requirements.note: The public-key 1.4.2 APK is built (e854703, SHA-256 5c02cc26…); the same build signed with the local test key, identical outside its signature, is installed and checked on the Redmi 13C and the 12 GB emulator. The public-key file itself has run only on an emulator (an earlier build, 0a26881), not on a phone.

requirements.obligation: Install and run within minutes without substantial debugging
requirements.note: Setup recommends a model for the phone's memory and downloads it and the collections from pinned Hugging Face revisions; on 24 October all 16 files the app downloads resolved with the size and SHA-256 it checks them against. Everything the app offers was downloaded through the app on an 18 October build of 1.4.2; the final public-key APK has not been set up from downloads on a clean phone.

requirements.obligation: Include assets or provide clear download and installation instructions
requirements.note: Models and collections download in the app from pinned Hugging Face revisions, each checked against its size and SHA-256; a .fapack can be imported instead.

requirements.obligation: Publish a public demo on X or Farcaster
requirements.note: Earlier demos show older builds; a 1.4.2 demo is still to be posted.

requirements.obligation: Demo offline use, hard queries, repository link, and approach
requirements.note: A 1.4.2 demo of offline use, hard questions and the repository link is still to be recorded.

requirements.obligation: Submit a relevant POIDH screenshot with demo and repository links
requirements.note: The existing claim describes an older build; it is to be updated after the 1.4.2 release.

requirements.obligation: Keep the functional reviewed version in GitHub at claim time
requirements.note: 1.4.2 is committed and built but not yet pushed, tagged or released; the claim must point at the released tag.

requirements.obligation: Avoid fraud, malware, plagiarism, material changes, and violations
requirements.note: Fork credited; third-party licences shipped in the app and listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

requirements.obligation: Measure against the greater-than-50-percent quality bar transparently
requirements.note: Measured transparently on sealed sets graded blind against web-researched answers, every grade published (docs/testing-1.4.2.md). On that measure Gemma 4 26B on 12 GB phones reaches 77% of the reference answers' average score, with a good answer to 115 of 160; Qwen3.5 4B 45% and Qwen3.5 2B 40%. The graders and references are AI models, so this is our own measurement; the organizers' scorecard rates research quality as a whole, not answer by answer.
